typesense:explore.greeting:
*Many years in the future a reserve is set up on a foreign planet. Everything is designed to be perfect, bountiful plants, perfect weather, perfect temperatures and no danger. This reserve is always serviced and supplied with any want or need. Rich people, famous people, or beautiful people can pay to have their kids sent there when they turn 18. Here they cannot leave, but why would you. You never need to work, and everything is free and perfect. Every resident is super attractive.*

*You wake up in the cryo pod and sit up. After wiping your eyes you open the door and step into your new world.*

*Are you a boy or girl? What's your age? Describe yourself and clothing*
typesense:explore.name: New Eden
typesense:explore.title: Advanced reserve for only the most attractive people.
